signature.name: VTask.lift
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> {M : ι → Type u_2} -> [(i : ι) → Monoid (M i)] -> {N : Type u_3} -> [Monoid N] -> ((i : ι) → M i →* N) ≃ (Monoid.CoprodI M →* N)

conventions.statement: The forward direction `VTask.lift.toFun fi` is the unique monoid homomorphism `Monoid.CoprodI M →* N` whose composite with each canonical inclusion `of : M i →* Monoid.CoprodI M` equals `fi i`.
conventions.note: This is the universal property direction: assemble a family into a single map.

conventions.statement: The inverse direction `VTask.lift.invFun f` recovers the family by setting the `i`-th component to `f.comp of`.
conventions.note: Pre-composing with the canonical inclusions extracts the summand maps.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {M : ι → Type*} [inst : (i : ι) → Monoid (M i)], VTask.lift (fun i => (Monoid.CoprodI.of : M i →* Monoid.CoprodI M)) = MonoidHom.id (Monoid.CoprodI M)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {M : ι → Type*} [inst : (i : ι) → Monoid (M i)] {N : Type*} [Monoid N] (f : (i : ι) → M i →* N), MonoidHom.mrange (VTask.lift f) = ⨆ i, MonoidHom.mrange (f i)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {M : ι → Type*} [inst : (i : ι) → Monoid (M i)] {N : Type*} [Monoid N] (f : (i : ι) → M i →* N) (s : Submonoid N), MonoidHom.mrange (VTask.lift f) ≤ s ↔ ∀ i, MonoidHom.mrange (f i) ≤ s

facts.statement: ¬ (∀ {ι : Type*} {M : ι → Type*} [inst : (i : ι) → Monoid (M i)] {N : Type*} [Monoid N] (fi gi : (i : ι) → M i →* N), VTask.lift fi = VTask.lift gi → ∀ i (m : M i), fi i m = gi i m → fi i m ≠ gi i m)
